text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: primary-east1 GPU pool saturated — autoscaler failing, queue growth detected at 95% of threshold. Pager routed to frank oncall. PAGER: urgent

frank: saw the pager, joining. frank: initial check — primary-east1 GPU utilization 99%, queue depth 42k, token-rate spike +3x. Autoscale logs show repeated 'quota limit' errors.

carmen: copying metrics: https://internal.metrics/redwood/primary-east1?range=1h — looks like scale attempts at 14:03, 14:04, 14:06 all throttled by cloud quota 24/24 CPUs/gpu.

dinesh: autoscaler is requesting new nodes but cloud API returns 429 quota_exceeded: "Insufficient quota to fulfill request". We hit regional vCPU/GPU soft limits.

elaine: customer-facing note — support-bot please start triage doc, tag customers on affected tiers (hosted/dedicated). We may need to throttle low-tier routes.

support-bot: created incident-2812345678 doc and notified 12 customers with potential latency > 5s. Template: "We're investigating a region capacity issue..."

frank: immediate mitigation options: 1) trigger cross-region spillover to west1 for new requests 2) apply per-customer throttles 3) manually evict low-priority workloads from primary pool. Which do we want first?

runtime-lead: prefer 1 then 3. Spillover policy should steer by route profile; keep high-priority customers in dedicated reserved capacity if available. We'll need to monitor tail-latency in west1.

mike: note — west1 has spare capacity but model variants differ (v1-quantized vs v1-fp16). Some customers on strict model pins will see degraded outputs.

carmen: trying a soft-steer now: posting routing override to control-plane: 

```
POST /v1/routing/overrides
{
  "from_region": "primary-east1",
  "to_region": "west1",
  "weight": 0.7,
  "routes": ["/v1/generate", "/v1/chat"]
}
```

frank: applied override. monitoring traffic shift. initial success — 55% of new requests now hitting west1. queue in primary stabilized somewhat.

dinesh: autoscaler still retrying but quota remains. I've opened cloud quota support ticket and escalated to cloud-ops. ETA unknown.

frank: evict plan next — runtime-lead can you start safe-evict of best-effort batches? Use drain-window=30s and lane=best-effort.

runtime-lead: starting eviction script now. snippet: 

```
# evict best-effort
for pool in primary-east1-pools:
  annotate pool eviction=best-effort
  drain pool --grace 30s --filter best-effort
```

runtime-lead: evictions in progress — freeing 6 GPUs, estimated reduce queue by ~8k.

elaine: support update queued to customers: "We've redirected traffic to an alternate region to reduce latency; some customers may see minor quality variance if pinned to model variants. Full resolution ETA pending cloud quota response."

mike: warning from telemetry — west1 tail latency spiking on long context jobs, ~2% errors 504. Rolling back some heavy-gen routes from spillover weight 0.7 -> 0.5.

carmen: adjusted override weight to 0.5. New traffic distribution looks smoother. primary-east1 queue trending down from 42k -> 30k.

frank: can we enable temporary per-route token caps for free-tier? That will reduce churn.
dinesh: pushing token-cap rules: 

```
PATCH /v1/limits
{
  "selector": "plan:free",
  "max_tokens_per_min": 5000
}
```

frank: token caps applied. Early signs: request rate from free-plan down 28%.

support-bot: updated incident doc with impacted customers list and mitigation steps; created follow-up tickets for customers with dedicated contracts.

mike: cloud-ops replied — they've increased soft quota for GPUS in east1 by +8, should be provisionable in ~18-24 minutes. That should let autoscaler fulfill pending requests.

frank: good. once quota is provisioned we'll rollback spillover and re-balance traffic. Plan for canary rollback: reduce override weight by 0.2 every 3 mins if primary queue keeps dropping.

runtime-lead: agree. also schedule a postmortem: root causes: quota exhaustion + autoscaler retry/backoff not durable under 429 storm. We'll need better pre-warming and standby pools.

elaine: communication plan: send interim update in 20m, note: customers on pinned models might get quality changes while spillover in effect. sales-esc to reach out to top 5 accounts now.

frank: current status at 14:20: primary queue 18k, west1 tail errors at 1%, autoscaler pending 8 GPUs, spillover weight 0.5, evicted 6 GPUs from best-effort. Paging team — stand by for next update.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE posted to #incidents and incident doc 2812345678. React with :white_check_mark: when you've read.
